text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's the Tracen Meet, so I head
toward the
track to watch.

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: You got this, Urara! Go for first place!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I won't give up until I win!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Urara! Do your best, but don't hurt
yourself!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I let you train with me, so I won't accept
anything
but the best performance
today!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So you're trying out for the lead role in
this opera too, huh? Then let us both
orchestrate a great
symphony and blow
them all away!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Orca straight? I'm not sure what that
means, but
I'll run as straight as I can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The starting signal sounds and...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Here I goooo! Wha—whoa, whoa,
whoaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Oh goodness! Haru Urara seems to have

overdone it and tumbled out of the
gate!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Owie... I scraped my knee... Oh no! I'm
being left
behind!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! I can't give up! I've gotta keep
going!
Urarararaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara stands up and starts running
with all
her might. However...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And the winner is T.M. Opera O! T.M.
Opera O is
first across the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... I... I made it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With thunderous applause from her
friends, Haru
Urara manages to finish in
last place.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A-are you all right, Urara?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... I'm fine! I just tripped a little in the beginning, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text:
But you really tried hard, Urara! Even
with your
fall, you managed to beat your
best time!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: REALLY?! I did it! Yippee!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well done! I can't believe how
courageously you
faced such a
challenge!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This calls for a round of applause! A big
round of
applause for the one who
stands second only to
moi!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At T.M. Opera O's words, the whole
audience
claps for Haru Urara's efforts.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wow! I don't know what I did to deserve
this, but
thank you!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What a truly brilliant opera! One only
you could
have performed!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If I am the sun, that makes you a
sunflower. Your luminosity lies in your
simple elegance. That is
what draws
people in.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I have no idea what you mean,
but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah! Sunflower seeds are super delicious!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You dummy! That's not the point!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the heart of this joyful scene stands
Haru
Urara, surrounded by warm smiles
and laughter.
